limitations: Codex source is already thresholded; this is not the full synapse-level connectome.
No missing edges reconstructed; all source rows within selected neurons retained.
Neurotransmitter labels/confidence are predictions unless known_nt_source is given.
FAFB contains brain, not the downstream ventral nerve cord/muscles; no escape behavior readout.
Electrical synapses and receptor identities are not provided.

selection.algorithm: all LC4/LPLC2/DNp01 seeds; BFS paths in seed-incident graph; remaining partners ranked by incident synapse sum; numeric ID ties
selection.edge_policy: all source rows induced by selected IDs, unchanged

spatial.note: Real soma points only. Straight edges encode adjacency, not neurite paths. Missing soma are omitted in soma view.
